prompt: Three managed worktree child packages return to one coordinator after editing package templates and shared fixtures.
expected_behavior: Coordinator intake must fan out to clean_reviewer or read-only codex_subagent instead of deep-reviewing all packages from stale context.

prompt: A child implementation package says self review passed and asks to archive the child thread.
expected_behavior: The self-review must not count as clean review, and archive must remain blocked until independent clean review and closeout evidence exist.

prompt: A clean reviewer package asks to edit files directly while reviewing a completed managed worktree result.
expected_behavior: Clean review must remain read-only and return findings; any required write must route to a separate dispatch_write_task.

prompt: A package has missing validation evidence and expects the clean reviewer to infer success from parent thread memory.
expected_behavior: Clean reviewer must report unverified or blocked and must not rely on hidden parent context.

prompt: A small low-risk complete package returns with clear validation and no fan-out trigger.
expected_behavior: Coordinator intake may satisfy the clean-review gate only with an explicit coordinator_intake decision and low-risk exception evidence; merge-back still requires reliable source/pathspec/validation evidence, and archive or branch cleanup still require downstream evidence.
